subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this combined Control UI issue stay open as the bridge between WebChat reply metadata and final-fallback semantics, or should maintainers split/close it in favor of the narrower canonical items?
rationale: The remaining work spans a new reply metadata contract plus broader terminal fallback delivery policy; source inspection shows both are only partially addressed on main, and the related open PR/issue are not a single complete canonical fix.

options.title: Keep As Bridge Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers either land a WebChat reply metadata contract or explicitly split the fallback-delivery half to the canonical issue.

options.title: Split To Canonical Items
options.body: Close this issue only after linking the reply-metadata half to the chosen PR or issue and the no-output half to the durable final fallback issue.

options.title: Sponsor Unified Control UI Contract
options.body: Ask for one focused PR that adds typed WebChat reply metadata through `chat.send` and agent runtime context while leaving cross-channel fallback policy to the canonical fallback issue.

recommendation.title: Keep As Bridge Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until maintainers either land a WebChat reply metadata contract or explicitly split the fallback-delivery half to the canonical issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The current main runtime-context carrier work is the closest merged code path for deciding how inbound metadata should reach agent sessions.
